snippet.title: The Fairly Odd Parents Flash Game- The Big Superhero Wish
snippet.description:
This game is based off the episode: The Big Superhero Wish (as that's the name of the game also :P) This one was pretty fun and hard when I was younger, but now I'm able to do it fairly easy now ;) Enjoy!

I do not own this flash game, all rights go to Nickelodeon.
